claims.text: The resort is at Quinta de Vale Abraao in Samodaes, Lamego.

findings.quote:
Quinta de Vale Abraão, Samodães

5100-758 Lamego
findings.note: The official contact address gives Quinta de Vale Abraão, Samodães, Lamego.

claims.text: The manor has been restored with contemporary interiors reflecting the region's heritage.

findings.quote: It has been beautifully restored, with contemporary interiors reflecting both the region's rich heritage and our Six Senses design values.
findings.note: States the restoration and the contemporary interiors reflecting regional heritage.

claims.text: Contemporary decor blends with natural materials and Portuguese design.

findings.quote: Contemporary décor blends with natural materials and authentic Portuguese design.

claims.text: Rooms, suites and villas are set within kitchen gardens and vineyards.

findings.quote: Spacious and comfortable rooms, suites and villas set within flourishing kitchen gardens and vineyards

claims.text: Rooms have vineyard views from huge windows.

findings.quote: Generously sized rooms with vineyard views from huge windows

claims.text: The spa offers locally inspired therapies, a heated pool, gym and yoga pavilion.

findings.quote: 10 treatment rooms administering locally inspired therapies, a heated pool, gym and yoga pavilion
findings.note: Lists every element of the claim.

claims.text: Activities include a gourmet river cruise and visits to historic wineries.

findings.quote: a gourmet river cruise and invitations to hidden jewels and historic wineries
findings.note: Covers both the river cruise and the historic wineries.

claims.text: The resort's Forest Restoration Project nurses its parkland back to health as a home for soil fertility, fungi, insects and birds.

findings.quote: The Forest Restoration Project is a true labor of love. We take great pride and pleasure in nursing this parkland back to health and making it a home for soil fertility, fungi, insects and birds.

claims.text: Douro Valley vintages can be tasted with guidance from the resort's sommelier.

findings.quote: Taste the best Douro Valley vintages, expertly guided by the resort's sommelier

claims.text: Dining uses homegrown vegetables and herbs and fresh produce from the valley.

findings.quote: Homegrown vegetables and herbs along with fresh produce harvested from the verdant valley

claims.text: The 19th-century manor sits high on a hill overlooking vine-covered terraces, with the Douro river at its feet.

findings.quote: This 19th-century manor sits high on a hill overlooking vine-covered terraces with the Douro river gently flowing at its feet.
findings.note: Matches every element of the claim.
